summary: Ohio's first fire tower: a 60-foot steel lookout built in 1924 in Shawnee State Forest, restored, climbable at visitors' own risk, on the NHLR since 1991.

facts.design: 60-foot steel tower with stairs and an observation cabin at the top

access.note: In Shawnee State Forest. Two later pages say visitors may climb to the top at their own risk. No hours or parking details given.

visit.trail_note: Climb at your own risk, per the Portsmouth and Scioto Historical pages. The 360-degree view covers the surrounding forest and hills. Sources give no hours or parking details.

facts.agency: Ohio Department of Natural Resources (Ohio Division of Forestry as cooperator)

events.note: Built by the state as the first fire tower in Ohio, a 60-foot steel tower on Copperhead Hill.
A Chillicothe Gazette item said James Morgan would man the tower, with Isom Morgan as his substitute.
A newspaper item said a short-wave station would be set up in the tower. The sources do not confirm it was completed.
Date registered on the National Historic Lookout Register: March 16, 1991 (US 15, OH 2).
NHLR visit report, October 2, 2003: needs paint, stairs appear to be rotting, no glass or shutters in the cab.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1924 clippings give the hill as 1,300 ft above sea level. The NHLR register gives the site as 1,246 ft (380 m). Portsmouth says over 1,200 ft and Scenic Scioto says 1,200 ft. The story keeps the register figure for the record and reports the spread.

notes_for_editor: Core history is consistent across the NHLR, Portsmouth, Scioto Historical and 1924-1948 clippings: built 1924, first fire tower in Ohio, 60-foot steel. The restoration has no date in any source read; 'recently restored' appears on pages that are themselves undated (Scioto Historical photos from 2011-2013; Portsmouth post dated 2022-02-04). The NHLR visit report (2003) is the only condition report and predates the restoration. The brief's access 'unknown' is replaced with public, climbable at own risk. The ODNR Copperhead page returned 404 to both fetch_text and WebFetch, so ODNR's own visit details are unchecked. The Scioto Historical URL is the mail. subdomain as cached. The date the tower stopped being staffed is not in any source. Staffing 'unstaffed' rests on the NHLR 'Staffed?' field alone.
